nom: COSRX The Retinol 0.1 Cream with Super Vitamin E & Panthenol

segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe sensitive skin and report the cream is gentle and non-irritating when introduced slowly (often via the moisturizer-retinol-moisturizer 'sandwich' method), though a few note stinging, tackiness, or redness at first use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it hydrating and helpful for locking in moisture, though some pair it with an extra moisturizer since retinol still feels drying to them.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found it non-irritating and reported improved acne, while another with unspecified oily-leaning skin found it left the face feeling oily and slick overnight.
segments.combination: A combination/acne-prone skin reviewer reports it smoothed texture concerns but caused some initial drying.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports no complaints and a good fit with her routine, but no visible improvement yet.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or fine lines (40s, nearing 40) report smoother skin and reduced fine lines/dark circles with continued use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their late 30s to 40s report smoother skin, reduced fine lines/wrinkles, brighter under-eyes, and more even tone after weeks of use; one is still uncertain if changes are due to the product.
concerns.dehydration: Many describe it as hydrating or moisture-locking, especially when layered with additional moisturizer; however, a few state it is drying, especially in the first weeks, or that it did not add moisture at all.
concerns.redness: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no redness or stinging, but one reviewer developed red, splotchy skin they suspect was an allergic reaction, and another described stinging on first use that resolved after using the sandwich method.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers introducing retinol slowly (sandwich method, 2-3x/week) report no irritation or compromised barrier; one used it to recover skin peeling from prescription tretinoin.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report clearer dark spots, faded post-acne marks, and more even skin tone after several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and even improved acne; one first-time user experienced breakouts near the eyebrows and cheeks in early weeks before improving.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the cream left their face feeling oily and slick, unlike most others who describe it as lightweight and fast-absorbing.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way

extraits.texte: I know that rednal is great for your skin at all but I notice that this one is very drying a little bit more than usual and that's why. I'm a little bit on the fence with it. I don't know if it's doing such a great job that it's drawing out my skin because I know retinal can be harsh the 1st couple of weeks you use it. It takes time to build-up your skin to be able to accept. But at the same time I don't know if my skin is just overly sensitive and not doing so well with it so that's why I'm a. Little bit fifty about it definitely we'll keep using it and seeing but I wish it was a little bit more hydrating

extraits.titre: I like it but not for me
extraits.texte: I loved the feel of the product on my skin and it was very hydrating but it left my face red and splotchy. Maybe I am allergic to something in this I'm not sure but it makes me very sad because I wanted to be able to use it.

This is my first time useing retinol and I am just turned 24 year old. My skin has been more on the dry side especially during the winter. I received a resurfacing chemical peel and then 2 weeks later started using the retinol. My skin feels so smooth after 4 weeks of using it ! Howeve in the very beginning my skin did break out in parts of my face that it has never done like near my eyebrow and my cheeks . This is a really nice product and a little goes a long way. It still looks like I barely used the products after applying only at night for 2-3 times a week for 4 weeks! I also use the snail mucin essence just about everyday other than cleanser, moisturizer and spf.

I love this product. My skin is really super sensitive. First time I used it- after I removed it- my skin had a stinging sensation. So I stopped immediately. For a whole week I used nothing else but moisturizer/barrier repair. After a week, I tried this product again but this time I used the sandwich method (moisturizer, retinol, moisturizer) and VOILA!!!! I started using it every 4 days, then . Now its just one day yes, one day no. My skin is looking smoother, softer... and my skin tone is looking a little more even. The only thing I don't like is that while you have it on- your skin feels tacky/sticky. I hate that feeling. But when you remove it skin feels as soft and smooth as a rose petal.

Great intro to retinol. I have sensitive, acne prone, oily skin. This did not irritate my skin, and honestly it has improved my acne. My skin has never looked better with Cosrx and i've been struggling with my skin since middle school. I am now 26.

This was very easy as a starting point for a new retinol user like me. As long as you incorporate it slowly and don't overuse until your skin is used it it, it will be fine! I have combo/acne prone skin and this did help smooth out some texture concerns I was having. It does cause a little bit of drying at first, but just make sure you're hydrating well.

I'm beginning to get some dark circles as I'm nearing the big 4 0 in a couple years and this change in my under eye area and little discoloration has had me really self-conscious, but when I added this retinol cream to my daily skincare regimen I began noticing right away that where I have the troublesome darkness under my eyes and uneven skin tone, the areas have began to brighten a bit and I love the more even skin tone I've noticed recently.
